about_the_game:
Over the course of development, we poured our passion into designing every ship, planet, and boss you'll face in the game. Our artbook offers a rare glimpse into that creative process. From early line art and unused concepts, to polished pixel art of the Mantis factions (Mantis, Rusty, and Urax), human ships, backgrounds, VFX, and even full pages from our comic-style cutscenes.

The artwork was created by our artist, Stanislav Dudas, who brought the world of Galaxy Highways to life with dedication and heart.

While reviewing the line art, we realized how much fun it would be to turn some of those drawings into a coloring book. Since both of us developers had small kids during development, we printed a few pages and they absolutely loved coloring them. So, we decided to include a coloring book in this DLC as well.

Whether you're a fan of pixel art, game development, or just curious about how Galaxy Highways came to life, we hope this collection brings you inspiration and joy. We truly loved making this game and we’d be thrilled if this artbook and coloring book helps you feel that love in every pixel.

Installation folder

DLC is installed into game installation folder, usually into: [Disk]:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Galaxy Highways\ArtBook_And_ColoringBook
